transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in today?
I... I came because I keep hearing voices. Like someone’s right there in my studio, but nobody is. They say my name, and... they say my work is being judged. It’s been hard to ignore.
Have you used any drugs or substances recently?
No... not really. I mean, I don’t use drugs. Nothing like that.
Do you believe someone is actually judging or monitoring your work?

I... yeah. I know it sounds strange, but yes. I feel like that other home-care agency, and some people from the library, they’ve been watching my paintings and my client papers. Like they’re trying to take something that was supposed to be mine. People tell me it doesn’t make sense, but... I still know it’s happening.
Have you had a period where you felt unusually high or full of energy for days at a time?

Yeah... sometimes. I get this energy and I just can’t sit down. I’ll clean the whole kitchen, start a few paintings, crochet for hours, redo care schedules... all in one night sometimes. It’s like I can’t stop.
When you have those high-energy times, do the voices get stronger?
Yeah... I think so. When I’m barely sleeping and I get caught up in all those art and care plans, that’s when I hear them more in the studio. And I feel more sure people are watching what I’m doing.
Have you ever heard the voices at a time when your energy was normal and you were sleeping normally?

Yes... there was a time like that. My energy had gone back down, and I was sleeping more regular, but the voices didn’t really stop. And I still felt like people were judging or tracking my work... for weeks, I think.
Have you ever had a period where you felt very depressed most of the day, nearly every day?
I... I don’t really know. I get low sometimes, but I’m not sure about most of the day, every day like that.
Have you ever had a time when you felt depressed nearly all day, almost every day, for at least two weeks?
I’m not really sure. I’ve had times I felt down, but… I don’t know if it was nearly all day for two weeks. I don’t keep track like that.
During one of those low periods, did you ever lose interest in almost everything you usually enjoy?
I’m not sure… I mean, I wasn’t doing much, but I don’t know if I lost interest in everything. I just kind of kept to myself.
Have you ever had a time when you felt sad or empty nearly all day, almost every day, for at least two weeks?
I don’t know… I’ve felt empty sometimes, yeah, but I can’t really say it was nearly all day every day for two weeks. I just don’t remember it that way.
During those high-energy times, did you feel unusually powerful or specially gifted?
Yeah… I guess I did. I really thought my artwork was going to be discovered any day, and that I was meant to put together this care-and-art program that doctors and agencies would come learn from me.
During those high-energy times, did you talk much more than usual or feel like you couldn't stop talking?
I don’t really know. Maybe I talked a little more, but I don’t remember feeling like I couldn’t stop or anything.
During those high-energy times, did you feel more important or powerful than usual?
Yeah… I did. I thought what I was doing was really important, like my art was about to be discovered and people—doctors and agencies—would come learn this program from me.
Have you ever had a time when you felt depressed nearly all day, almost every day, for at least two weeks?
I’m not really sure. I’ve had low times, but… I don’t know if it was nearly all day every day for two weeks like that.
During those high-energy times, did you need much less sleep than usual and still feel rested?
Yeah… that happened. I’d sleep maybe two or three hours, sometimes for a few nights, and still get up feeling kind of charged. Like I could just go right back to painting or making calls.
During those high-energy times, did they ever get so severe that you were hospitalized?
I… I’m not sure how to answer that. I don’t really want to get into all that. I don’t think I can say for sure.
Did any of those high-energy periods last a full week or longer?
Yeah… I think so. It wasn’t just a few days. Those times have been kind of coming and going for… maybe close to a year now. Like, about eleven months.
Were the voices still there for at least two weeks during a time when you were not having a high-energy period or a depressed period?

Yeah… I think so. After my energy came down and I was sleeping more normal, the voices didn’t just stop. That feeling like people were judging me or keeping track of my work… it stayed around for a few weeks.
Looking over the whole time you’ve been unwell, have the voices and feeling that people were watching your work been there for most of that time, or only during certain periods?
It’s been there for most of it, I guess… not every single minute, but the voices and that feeling about my work being watched have been going on about nine months.
